texts.preamble: Da vs Subhash Chander Etc. on 8 August, 2018 In The Court Of Samar Vishal, Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate Ii, Patiala House Courts, New Delhi Cc No. 43384/2016 Date of Institution : 22.10.2010 Date of reserving judgement : 08.08.2018 Date of pronouncement : 08.08.2018 In re: Delhi Administration / Food Inspector Department of Pfa, Govt. of Nct of Delhi A-20, Lawrence Road Industrial Area, Delhi-110035 ... Complainant versus A-1) Sh Subhash Chander S/o Sh. Gopi Ram, M/s Indo Agro Industries, R/o 2/144 Geeta Colony, New Delhi-110031 R/o 2/144, First Floor, Geeta Colony, New Delhi 110031 A-2) Sh. Munna Singh S/o Sh. Mahadev Singh M/s Indo Agro Industries, 2/144 Geeta Colony, Delhi-110031 R/o 2/144,First Floor, Geeta Colony, Delhi-110031 A-3) M/s Indo Agro Industries 2/144 Geeta Colony, Delhi-110031 ... Accused person Cc No. 43384/2016 Page No. 1/7 Da vs Subhash Chander etc. Judgment: Da vs Subhash Chander Etc. on 8 August, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/56164294/ 1 1. The present is a complaint filed under section 16 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1
texts.facts: The present is a complaint filed under section 16 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1 954 (herein after referred to as PFA Act), alleging that the accused have violated the provisions of the PFA Act and Rules. 2. As per the complaint, on 19.5.2010 at about 10.15AM, Food Inspector Hukam Singh purchased a sample of 'Packaged Drinking Water' an article of food for analysis from accused No. 1 Subhash Chander at M/s Indo Agro Industries, 2/144 Geeta Colony, New Delhi-110031, where the said food article was found stored for sale and where accused Subhash Chander was found vending the article of food at the time of taking the sample. The sample consisted of 48 sealed pouches of 250 ml. each of "Packaged Drinking Water" taken as such each having identical label declaration. The sample was taken to under the supervision/direction of Sh. D.P. Singh, SDM/LHA. Food Inspector divided the sample of the article of food into three equal parts then and there by putting 16 sealed pouches in three clean and dry jars, each jar containing the sample was separately marked, packed, fastened and sealed according to the PFA Act, 1954 & Rules,1955. The vendor's signatures were obtained on the LHA slip and wrapper of the jar containing the sample. Notice in Form VI was given to accused Subhash Chander and the price of sample Rs. 48/- was also paid to him vide vendor receipt dated 19.5.2010. Panchnama too was prepared at the spot. All the documents prepared by F.l. were signed by accused Subhash Chander and the other witness Sh. Balwant Shah. FA. Before DA vs Subhash Chander etc. taking the sample efforts were made to get the public witnesses to join the proceedings but none came forward, as such Sh. Balwant Shah, FA was joined as witness. 3. One counter-part of the sample bearing LHA Code Number 21/LHA/28455 in intact condition along with copy of memo in Form VII on 19.5.2010 and another copy of memo in Form VII under seal cover were sent separately to the Public Analyst, Delhi and two counterparts of the sample along with two copies of memos in Form VII were deposited with the SDM/LHA in intact conditions on 19.5.2010. All copies of Memos in Form Vll bear the seal impression with which sample parts were sealed. Public Analyst analysed the sample and found the sample to be Misbranded. The report of Public Analyst is as follows: "The public analyst vide report number PFA/Enf./1157/2010 dated 15-06-2010 has reported that the sample is misbranded because there is violation of Rule 49(28) of PFA Act & Rules. However contents conform to standard of packaged drinking water. The public analyst has also reported in his report regarding label :- Complies with Rule-32, without lSI certification mark". 4. It is the case of the complainant that accused No. 1 Subhash Chander was the vendor-cum-partner of accused No. 3 M/s lndo Agro Industries, 2/144 Geeta Colony, New Delhi-110031 at the time of taking sample and he looks after its day to day business and as such he is in charge of and responsible for the conduct of the business of the said firm. Accused No.3 M/s lndo Agro Industries is a partnership firm having two partners i.e. accused No. 1 Subhash Chander and accused No.2 Munna Singh. Da vs Subhash Chander Etc. on 8 August, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/56164294/ 2 DA vs Subhash Chander etc. Accused No. M/s Indo Agro Industries has appointed accused No. 2 Munna Singh as nominee under the provision of PFA Act/Rules and he looks after its day to day business and as such he is also incharge of and responsible for the conduct of business of the firm. The sampled article of food "Packaged Drinking Water" was packed by M/s lndo Agro Industries. Being a partnership firm M/s Indo Agro Industries is also liable. 5. Thereafter on completion of investigation, sanction under section 20 of the PFA Act was obtained from the Director PFA. The complaint was then filed in the court on 22.10.2010 alleging violation of Section 2 (ix)(k)of PFA Act, 1954 and Rule 49(28) of PFA Rules 1955 as punishable section 7/16(1)(a) of PFA Act against the accused. 6. As the complaint was filed in writing by a public servant, recording of pre-summoning evidence was dispensed with and the accused was summoned vide order dated 22.10.2010. Based on the report of the PA notice was framed against the accused for commission of the offence punishable under section 7/16(1) (a) PFA Act being violation of Section 2 (ix)(k)of PFA Act, 1954, to which accused pleaded not guilty and claimed trial. 7. At the trial, the prosecution examined four witness in support of its case i.e. PW-1 FI Hukam Singh, PW-2 FA Balwant Shah and PW- 3 FI Arun Kumar. PW-1 and PW-2 were part of the team that had visited the spot for sample proceedings under the supervision of SDM/LHA Sh. D.P. Singh. These witness narrated the steps undertaken by them during the sample proceedings, including DA vs Subhash Chander etc. disclosing their identity, expressing intention to purchase sample for analysis, lifting the sample commodity of 48 packed drinking water of 250 ml each from the vendor for analysis, bearing identical label declaration, taking the sample of packed drinking water, dividing the sample into three equal parts by putting 16 pouches each in three clean and dry plastic jars, separately sealing, packing and marking the same and obtaining signatures of vendor and witnesses. They also proved the necessary documents including the vendor's receipt Ex.PW-1/A, Notice Ex. PW-1/B, Panchnama Ex.PW-1/C. The accused furnished his statement Ex.PW1/D on the spot. Thereafter, the one counter parts of the sample in intact condition along with two copies of memo of Form VII in a sealed packet were deposited with PA vide Receipt Ex.PW1/D and remaining two counterparts alongwith two copies of Form VII were deposited with LHA vide LHA receipt Ex.PW1/E. Thereafter, PA Report was received. Thereafter during the course of investigation, PW3 Arun Kumar sent letter Ex.PW3/A to Indo Agro Industries, 2/144, Geeta Colony, Delhi and received reply Ex.PW-3/B alongwith copy of nomination form Mark 3/1 and copy of partnership deed mark 3/2. The then SDM also sent letter Ex.PW-3/C to VATO, Ward No.80 but it was not replied. On conclusion of investigation, PW3 Arun Kumar put the entire case file before the concerned SDM / LHA, who forwarded the same to the then Director PFA for obtaining his Consent and Shri K.S.Singh, who granted his Consent Ex. PW-3/D for prosecution of accused after applying his mind. Then, PW-3 Sh Arun Kumar filed the complaint Ex. PW 3/E before this Court. Then Intimation letter alongwith copies of PA Report were sent to the accused persons through registered post which were not DA vs Subhash Chander etc. received back undelivered. These witnesses were duly cross- examined by Ld. Defence Counsel. Da vs Subhash Chander Etc. on 8 August, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/56164294/ 3 8. Statement of the accused under section 313 CrPC were recorded wherein the accused denied the allegations and pleaded innocence.
